title: Unit 9: What a Job!: Second Conditional & Work Vocabulary
objective: Mampu menggunakan passive voice (present simple, past simple, present continuous, present perfect) untuk menggambarkan aksi yang menekankan objek, serta menguasai kosakata pekerjaan dan ekspresi waktu menggunakan 'in'.

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas penggunaan passive voice dalam berbagai bentuk waktu (present simple, past simple, present continuous, present perfect). Passive voice digunakan ketika kita tidak tahu atau tidak ingin menyebutkan siapa yang melakukan aksi, atau ketika fokus pada objek yang dikenai aksi. Selain itu, unit ini juga membahas perbedaan penggunaan 'work' (kata kerja/kata benda tak terhitung) dan 'job' (kata benda terhitung), serta penggunaan preposisi 'work as/in/for'.
rules: Passive Voice dibentuk dengan: to be + past participle. Contoh: The sweets are made in the factory. (Present Simple Passive)
Past Simple Passive: was/were + past participle. Contoh: Ben was paid $111,000 for six months' work.
Present Continuous Passive: is/are being + past participle. Contoh: Many jobs are being replaced by machines.
Present Perfect Passive: has/have been + past participle. Contoh: The Internet has been used by people all over the world for 30 years.
'Work' sebagai kata benda tidak bisa dijadikan plural (uncountable). Contoh: I have a lot of work to do.
'Job' adalah countable noun dan bisa dijadikan plural. Contoh: She did four jobs before she became a travel agent.
Work as = bekerja sebagai (profesi). Contoh: There were men who worked as lamplighters.
Work for = bekerja untuk (perusahaan/organisasi). Contoh: Harry Willsher works for Swizell's.
Work in = bekerja di (bidang/industri). Contoh: Marina Stuart got an offer to work in television.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Passive Voice dengan Subject yang Salah
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula lupa bahwa dalam passive voice, subject kalimat adalah objek yang dikenai aksi, bukan pelaku aksi. Selain itu, kesalahan umum lain adalah menggunakan 'work' sebagai countable noun.
commonTrap.wrong: The factory makes the sweets. → The factory is made the sweets. / I have four works to finish.
commonTrap.correct: The factory makes the sweets. → The sweets are made in the factory. / I have four jobs to finish. OR I have a lot of work to do.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat bahasa Inggris berikut yang menggunakan passive voice dengan benar dalam bentuk Present Simple?
options: The sweets are made in the factory every day.
The sweets are being made in the factory every day.
The sweets have been made in the factory every day.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Passive voice dalam Present Simple dibentuk dengan 'is/are + past participle'. Kalimat 'The sweets are made in the factory every day' menggunakan pola ini dengan tepat. Opsi kedua menggunakan Present Continuous Passive ('are being made') dan opsi ketiga menggunakan Present Perfect Passive ('have been made'), keduanya tidak sesuai dengan konteks kebiasaan sehari-hari (every day) yang memerlukan Present Simple Passive.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Dalam passive voice, subjek kalimat adalah objek yang dikenai aksi, bukan pelaku. Selain itu, 'work' sebagai kata benda bersifat uncountable. Manakah kalimat berikut yang BENAR?
options: I have four works to finish before Friday.
She applied for three jobs at different companies.
He has many jobs to do at the office today.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Kata 'job' adalah countable noun sehingga bisa dijamakkan menjadi 'jobs'. Kalimat 'She applied for three jobs at different companies' benar karena menggunakan 'jobs' untuk menyatakan jumlah pekerjaan yang bisa dihitung. Opsi pertama salah karena 'work' sebagai kata benda tidak bisa dijamakkan (seharusnya 'a lot of work'). Opsi ketiga kurang tepat karena konteks 'banyak tugas di kantor hari ini' lebih natural menggunakan 'a lot of work to do' daripada 'many jobs'.

readinessQuestions.prompt:
Perhatikan percakapan berikut:

Ryan: "Well, you missed the new headmistress's announcement yesterday."
Olivia: "Oh? What about?"
Ryan: "A lot of changes [...] next semester."

Isilah bagian [...] dengan respons yang paling tepat menggunakan passive voice.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Konteks kalimat membicarakan perubahan yang akan dilakukan pada semester depan, sehingga memerlukan passive voice bentuk future: 'are going to be made'. Opsi 'are making' adalah active voice dan memerlukan subjek pelaku, bukan 'changes'. Opsi 'has been making' juga active voice dalam Present Perfect Continuous dan tidak sesuai secara gramatikal maupun kontekstual.

vocab.collocation: I did it when I first left school, just to earn money.
I had to remember the customers' orders, but that was all, really. It wasn't very challenging.
I didn't get paid holidays, so that wasn't good.
So after about five months I gave in my notice and got a job as a shop assistant.
After a few months I was promoted to store manager.
I was happy because I was starting a career — well, I thought I was. I got on-the-job training about management and things.
The pay is fantastic and the work is quite interesting. I guess you can say I'm successful.
In the past, there were many jobs that now no longer exist. These are called obsolete jobs.

dialogue.context: Percakapan antara Ryan, Olivia, Luke, dan Megan yang sedang merencanakan kegiatan amal untuk mengumpulkan dana bagi taman bermain anak-anak.

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.text: Hi, Olivia. What happened to you yesterday?
lines.translation: Hai, Olivia. Apa yang terjadi padamu kemarin?

lines.speaker: Olivia
lines.text: Oh, I just didn't feel very good. I'm all right now though. By the way, here's your book back, Ryan.
lines.translation: Oh, aku hanya tidak enak badan. Tapi sekarang sudah baikan. Ngomong-ngomong, ini bukumu, Ryan.

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.text: Oh, thanks. Well, you missed the new headmistress's announcement yesterday.
lines.translation: Oh, terima kasih. Kamu ketinggalan pengumuman kepala sekolah baru kemarin.

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.text: We've been asked to do something for charity. Miss Dawes wants to raise money for the playground in the park. They really need some new things.
lines.translation: Kita diminta melakukan sesuatu untuk amal. Bu Dawes ingin mengumpulkan uang untuk taman bermain di taman. Mereka sangat butuh beberapa peralatan baru.

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.text: We thought the four of us could do something together. Want to join us, Olivia?
lines.translation: Kami pikir kita berempat bisa melakukan sesuatu bersama. Mau ikut, Olivia?

lines.speaker: Olivia
lines.text: Well, yes, that'd be great. As long as we can have some fun too!
lines.translation: Ya, itu bagus. Asal kita juga bisa bersenang-senang!

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.text: That's not the point, Olivia. It's not about fun. It's about raising money for a good cause.
lines.translation: Bukan itu intinya, Olivia. Ini bukan soal bersenang-senang. Ini tentang mengumpulkan uang untuk tujuan baik.

speakingLab.context: Latihan percakapan dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang pekerjaan impian dan nilai-nilai penting dalam pekerjaan.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we're going to talk about jobs and careers. Let me start with a question: What kind of job would you like to have in the future?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I would like to work as a teacher because I enjoy helping people learn new things.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's wonderful! Teaching is a very rewarding career. Now, what values are most important to you in a job? For example, is it the money, helping people, creativity, or free time?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I think helping people is the most important value for me. I'd rather be a teacher than a banker because it's more meaningful.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent answer! It's great that you know what matters to you. One more question: do you think some jobs will become obsolete in the future? Which ones?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I think there won't be any cleaners when I'm older. Machines and robots will do that job.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Very interesting prediction! You're thinking about how technology changes the world of work. Well done today!

quiz.question: Complete the sentence with the correct passive form: The sweets ________ in the company's factory.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan present simple passive: are/is + past participle. 'Sweets' adalah plural, jadi gunakan 'are made'.

quiz.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: I have four works to finish today.
I have four jobs to finish today.
I have many work to do.
She has two works in the city.
quiz.answer: I have four jobs to finish today.
quiz.explanation: 'Job' adalah countable noun dan bisa dijadikan plural. 'Work' sebagai kata benda adalah uncountable dan tidak bisa menggunakan 'four works'.

quiz.question: Complete: Harry Willsher works ________ Swizell's company.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'work for' ketika menyebutkan nama perusahaan atau organisasi tempat seseorang bekerja.

quiz.question: Change to passive voice: 'Ben showed that he was good at blogging.' → Ben showed that he was good at blogging, so _________.
options: he was asked lots of questions
they asked him lots of questions
quiz.answer: he was asked lots of questions
quiz.explanation: Passive voice untuk past simple: was/were + past participle. Fokus pada Ben yang menerima aksi (ditanya), bukan yang bertanya.

quiz.question: Complete: Marina Stuart got an offer to work ________ television.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'work in' ketika menyebutkan bidang atau industri, seperti 'in television', 'in education', 'in the computer industry'.

quiz.question: Which sentence uses present perfect passive correctly?
options: For the last 30 years, the Internet has been used by people all over the world.
For the last 30 years, the Internet is used by people all over the world.
For the last 30 years, the Internet was used by people all over the world.
For the last 30 years, the Internet uses by people all over the world.
quiz.answer: For the last 30 years, the Internet has been used by people all over the world.
quiz.explanation: Present perfect passive dibentuk dengan: has/have been + past participle. Digunakan untuk aksi yang dimulai di masa lalu dan berlanjut hingga sekarang.
